claim_boundary: A positive result establishes omission sensitivity only for w035 material that the independent surface-m7 source already supports near the known reference surface. It does not establish complete discovery of unknown papyrus outside an arbitrary inventory, physical recto identity, or Grand Prize eligibility.

decision.interpretation: Passing is necessary but not sufficient for promotion. A positive result unlocks Stage B: extract witnesses without conditioning on the known surface and measure false unexplained clusters on intact real papyrus. Failure retains EXPERIMENT FURTHER or DISMISS depending on mechanism; thresholds may not be rewritten after observation.
